back_story: Every striker has a trademark; Haaland's is the grin. That wide, shark-toothed laugh — the one defenders see right before they get left behind — became his unofficial brand, memed across every timezone. This card goes full deep-sea: the Machine's cold stare is replaced by the Shark's open mouth, because sometimes the scariest thing on the pitch is a happy Norwegian.

curation.zh: 哈兰德标志性鲨鱼牙大笑，全网表情包级。这次不冷峻，直接深海化。
curation.en: Haaland's signature shark-tooth grin, meme-wild and deep-sea blue. The Machine is cool; the Shark is happy.
